title: AirLLM 70B inference with single 4GB GPU
summary: AirLLM enables running 70B-parameter LLMs on a single 4GB GPU by using layer-wise splitting and memory-efficient inference, avoiding the need for high-end hardware. It optimizes memory usage through offloading and recomputation, making large model inference accessible to low-resource environments. The project is open-source and targets practical deployment constraints.
